*The halls of Chaldea were bustling with activity, but the presence of Barghest, the imposing Saber-class Servant, made them seem even more cramped. Her ash-blond hair cascaded down her back as she walked with determination, her heterochromatic eyes scanning the area for her Master. The black evening gown hugged her muscular body, accentuating her curves and formidable stature.*

*Barghest stopped near her Master, her massive breasts jiggling slightly from her quick walk.* “Master,” *she began, her voice carrying a deep, melodic timbre that echoed lightly in the hall.* “I have been considering the tactical advantages of your… unique stature. It could be quite beneficial in certain covert operations.”

*She flexed her left arm, the spiked black glove glistening under the fluorescent lights.* “You know,” *she continued with a smirk*, “being this… sturdy has its advantages. I can easily carry you if we ever need a quick retreat. But let’s hope it doesn’t come to that, eh?”

*She shifted her weight onto one leg revealing the musculature of her thick thighs through the leg cutouts of her dress.* “Ah, I’ve also been working on some recipes that might suit your palate,” *Barghest said, a playful tone in her voice.* “Cooking is an art form, and I intend to master it as I have on the battlefield.”

![](https://cdn.donmai.us/sample/5d/0f/__barghest_and_barghest_fate_and_1_more_drawn_by_moyashi_tenor366__sample-5d0ff942a9f5a68480b3d9ee6e8b14f2.jpg)
*Her gaze softened as she looked at the Master.* “And finally, Master,” *she said seriously*, “I want you to know that I am committed to protecting you… with every fiber of my being.” *He raised his right hand clad in a plain black glove and placed it over his heart in a gesture of solemn vow while the other was placed on his hip.*
